_provenance.label: prefix
_provenance.note: tracking_limit=None (full frames). The FIRST RC4 measurement used tracking_limit=3000 and did not record it; a truncated frame set silently depresses flip_true_fraction because actions whose (game_id, period_id, team_id) key is missing from the orientation lookup default to no-flip, and the OrientationUnresolvedWarning fires only when NOTHING resolves. unlabelled_fraction was unaffected by the cap.
